# Cirrus Mail

> Cirrus Mail is an open-source (MIT) email suite that runs entirely on your own Cloudflare account. Email Routing receives mail, Email Sending sends it, D1 and R2 store it, and one Hono Worker serves a React webmail and the API. It gives you real mailboxes on your own domains, with a web app, an admin console, CalDAV/CardDAV, a JMAP server and an iOS beta. It needs Workers Paid and a domain on Cloudflare DNS. There is no IMAP, because Workers can't accept inbound TCP connections; mail apps connect over JMAP instead. The project is in beta.

## Deploy it

- [Setup guide](https://github.com/jackh54/cirrus-mail/blob/main/docs/setup.md): prerequisites, Email Sending and Email Routing, button and CLI deploy, first-run setup, catch-all rule, troubleshooting
- [FAQ](https://github.com/jackh54/cirrus-mail/blob/main/docs/faq.md): cost, limits, privacy, acceptable use, IMAP vs JMAP, import, native app
- [Condensed guide for LLMs](https://github.com/jackh54/cirrus-mail/blob/main/llms-full.txt): all of the above in one file
- [Deploy to Cloudflare button](https://deploy.workers.cloudflare.com/?url=https://github.com/jackh54/cirrus-mail)
